dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, would you like to view my Genius Invokation Matches database? I just finished auto-simulating an additional 127 match scenarios. In case you were wondering, "auto-simulation" involves playing cards against myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Match duration time-out. For the sake of your health, it is recommended that you take regular breaks. If required, I can accompany you on a pleasant walk outside.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Victory. The data from this match is worth recording and has been added to the database: Genius Invokation Matches.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Complete and utter failure... But do not worry, I will be fine. Failure is simply success in progress.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Genius Invokation invitation confirmed. Switching to game mode...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Match added to database. Would you like to adjust the difficulty parameters before we play again?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Match Summary: Your card skills are significantly above average. I recommend you challenge opponents with higher difficulty parameters.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Data collection complete. Analyzing skill level to provide a more challenging experience...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...An unexpected process caused the result to deviate from predictions. Please begin another round so that I can help you attempt to correct the error.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Congratulations, you have achieved a new high score on this difficulty. You rank first among all players I have faced.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
